sql: CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW erp_sales WITH CONTAINER kola AS SELECT r.month AS month, r.city AS city, r.channel AS channel, r.sku AS sku, CAST(r.units AS BIGINT) AS units, CAST(r.unit_price_ngn AS DOUBLE) AS unit_price_ngn, CAST(r.revenue_ngn AS DOUBLE) AS revenue_ngn FROM kola_systems.erp_sales_src LATERAL VIEW explode(records) AS r
